note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000 (gameplay classification). The economy is a mixed economy: market reforms and NAFTA (1994) coexisted with state monopolies in oil (Pemex) and electricity. Trade is free trade under NAFTA. Military service is compulsory in law for young men but selected by lottery with part-time training, so selective conscription fits best. The press is classed as regulated rather than free because broadcasting was concentrated and long aligned with the governing party; this is a gameplay judgement. Church and state are strictly separated under the constitution, though the 1992 reforms restored legal status to churches. Healthcare is mainly social insurance (IMSS, ISSSTE) with a public safety net for the uninsured.
